propositions: Bridge is hardwired to one tracker project at three points (config scalar, inbound fetcher, outbound applier) and cannot sync multiple projects against one codebase.
One shared ticket store should own the project-to-repos mapping at .bridge_state/projects.json to prevent snapshot diff corruption when multiple repos fetch different project subsets.
Ticket project field is tri-state (absent=legacy, explicit-empty=never sync, explicit key=sync there) and resolves via store mapping without writing migration events.
Multi-project inbound fetch must iterate configured projects for base JQL and three enrichment passes (parent/comment/issuelink), merging results by issue key into shared snapshot.
Store receives multi-project-bridge capability stamp in required_capabilities exactly when mapping holds >1 project, causing older binaries to fail closed on multi-project stores.
Cross-project outbound guard relaxes from single project check to set membership, with explicit per-ticket project field replacing repo default on create.
